Designed for succulents and air plants, these planters are perfect to decorate a table or window sill. Each planter is handmade by a local artist in northeast Indiana. 5"L x 3"W x 2"H Designed for succulents and air plants Felt pads underneath prevent scratching surfaces Made by hand in the United States No additional drip tray required as the bottom is solid Since each piece is handmade expect variations
